Do you enjoy precision shaping pipes and creating strong welds for technical installations? As a TIG or semi-automatic welder, you'll work on a variety of HVAC projects within the construction sector. You'll read plans, build custom installations, and weld pipes into perfect assemblies for heating and plumbing. Depending on the project, you'll work both on-site and in the workshop, preparing and assembling components. Thanks to the variety of high-end projects, your job remains technically challenging and educational. You'll be part of a large team where collaboration, quality, and safety are paramount.

What are your tasks?

• Reading and interpreting technical plans
• Bending, grinding, and welding pipes (TIG/semi-automatic)
• Preparing and assembling installations in the workshop and on-site

• Experience as a welder in a technical or construction environment
• Communicate in English or Romanian
• Possession of a driver's license

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

This international company specializes in the production and supply of plastic components for the automotive industry, including injection-moulded parts for vehicles.

Jobomschrijving

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machine park.

You will work in a two-shift system:

• Early shift: 06:00–14:00
• Late shift: 14:00–22:00
As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your expertise, production processes remain reliable and downtime is kept to a minimum.

Your tasks and responsibilities

• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.
• Troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical breakdowns.
• Analysing faults and looking for sustainable solutions.
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.
• Actively contributing to optimizations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machine park.
• Working closely with the production department to minimize downtime.
• Working according to applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.
• Helping to maintain a clean, safe and well-organized working environment.

• A technical qualification in Electromechanics, Electrical Engineering, Automation or a similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Experience in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery.
• Knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.
• Basic knowledge of PLC control systems is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to develop this knowledge internally.
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but is not required.
• A good command of Dutch.
• The ability to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.
• Strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.
• A hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
• Good team spirit combined with the ability to carry out interventions independently.

Industry- automation systems warehouse

Jobomschrijving

For a company that designs, integrates, and maintains logistics automation solutions to optimize internal logistics processes in warehouses, production, and distribution

Your Responsibilities:

• Maintenance, repair, and installation of complex warehouse automation systems.
• Ensure smooth operation of our installations by performing timely maintenance and resolving technical issues quickly and efficiently.
• Analyze malfunctions and resolve them independently, with an eye for safety and customer satisfaction.
• Work mostly independently, but be a team player when necessary.
• Report your interventions in our system to ensure and improve quality.

• Diploma in electromechanics, electricity, and/or mechanics.
• Basic knowledge of automation is a plus, such as knowledge of SCADA, use of multimeters.
• Several years of experience in a technical role is a plus.
• Work independently, accurately, and customer-oriented.
• Fluent communication in Dutch and/or English.
• No fear of heights; our work takes place at different levels.
• Good physical condition for physical work.
• Flexible and willing to work occasionally outside standard hours.
• Motivated, responsible, and keep administration tidy.
• Eager to learn and share a passion for technology.
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, PLC control systems; if this appeals to you, this job is for you.
• All-round PC skills and experience with CMMS systems, (Sprocket).
• “You are open to working weekends.

You will work in Ninove, in a modern and highly automated environment specialized in logistics automation and automated warehouse systems.

The company develops, integrates and maintains automation solutions that help warehouses, production environments and distribution centers operate more efficiently.

Jobomschrijving

For an internationally active company specialized in automated warehouse systems and logistics automation, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Automation Technician / PLC Technician to join the permanent night shift team.

You will ensure that highly automated warehouse and logistics systems continue to operate efficiently and reliably.

As an Automation Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of automated installations.

Your responsibilities:

• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on complex automated installations.
• Diagnosing and resolving technical faults and breakdowns.
• Troubleshooting issues in electrical, mechanical and automated systems.
• Working with PLC controls, sensors, motors and SCADA systems.
• Ensuring that automated warehouse installations operate safely and efficiently.
• Carrying out technical interventions independently and identifying the root cause of malfunctions.
• Recording maintenance activities and interventions correctly in the CMMS system (Sprocket).
• Working independently during the permanent night shift, while consulting colleagues when necessary.
• Contributing to the safety, reliability and efficiency of the installations.

• A technical degree in electromechanics, electricity, automation and/or mechanics.
• Several years of experience as an Automation Technician, Maintenance Technician, Service Technician, Troubleshooting Technician or PLC Technician.
• Basic knowledge of industrial automation and PLC systems.
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, electrical components and technical installations.
• Experience with or an interest in SCADA and CMMS systems.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• A proactive, independent and accurate working attitude.
• A good command of Dutch and/or English.
• No fear of heights, as you may work at different levels within the automated installations.
• Good physical fitness.
• A strong interest in technology and a willingness to continue learning.
• The flexibility and motivation to work in 2 shifts

jobs.occupation: Sales Operations Manager | Brecht | Vast Contract
jobs.description:
Sales operations manager

Are you an experienced people manager who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-paced operational environment? Do you combine strong leadership skills with a hands-on approach to order management, backlog management and customer service?

For an international and dynamic organization, I am looking for a Sales Operations Manager to lead a team of four employees.

In this role, you will be close to both the people and the operation. You will coach and develop your team, set priorities, monitor performance and ensure that customers and internal stakeholders receive clear and timely follow-up.

Your responsibilities 

 
• Lead, organize, motivate and coach a team of 4 employees on a daily basis. 
 
• Oversee order and backlog management and ensure customer service enquiries are handled efficiently. 
 
• Set priorities and distribute the workload evenly across the team. 
 
• Monitor team performance, operational metrics and KPIs, and take action where needed. 
 
• Identify training and development needs and provide ongoing coaching. 
 
• Conduct regular one-to-one meetings and performance evaluations. 
 
• Listen to team members' feedback and support them in resolving challenges or conflicts. 
 
• Create sufficient space for team members to contribute to improvement projects alongside their daily responsibilities. 
 
• Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve escalations and ensure clear communication regarding priorities, progress and expected deliverables. 
 
• Provide management with feedback on operational challenges and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 
• Contribute to a positive and collaborative working environment and organize team-building activities. 

Who are we looking for?

For this position, I am looking for someone who knows how to lead and develop people while maintaining a strong overview of the operational priorities. 

 
• You have several years of experience in a leadership or coordinating position, ideally within sales operations, order management or customer service. 
 
• You have proven people management experience and enjoy coaching, motivating and developing team members. 
 
• You have experience with backlog management and are strong at setting priorities and maintaining overview. 
 
• You are an excellent coordinator and communicator who can effectively manage expectations with different stakeholders. 
 
• You are comfortable monitoring KPIs and using them to drive team performance. 
 
• You have strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 
• You remain calm and effective in a dynamic environment and know how to manage competing priorities. 
 
• You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively. 
 
• You have solid computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office, CRM systems and SAP. 
 
• You are fluent in English. Additional languages are an asset, but not a requirement. 
 
• Experience with data modelling and data management tools is considered an advantage.

Do you have what it takes to shine as a true forklift hero in the frozen food industry?

• Your eye for detail and accuracy make you the king/queen of precision work. 
 

 
• You're a true team player and communicate easily with your colleagues. 
 
• You speak fluent English and are willing to learn Dutch. The company offers Dutch lessons before or after your shift.

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Data department builds and maintains both future-ready and traditional data platforms, tools, and services to ensure easy, secure data access. It empowers data consumers with self-service capabilities while upholding governance and quality standards.

The department delivers scalable, compliant, and user-centric data solutions to meet business needs. Within this framework, the Tribe designs and implements structured, optimized data stores for APIs, reporting, and analytics. They ensure compliance, security, and governance of data assets through modern data management practices, supported by high-quality documentation and tooling. Their mission is to enable reliable, scalable, and well-governed data consumption across the organization.

At BNP Paribas Fortis, you will contribute to innovation by designing advanced data pipelines and infrastructure that power AI, real-time analytics, and strategic decision-making as part of our digital transformation. 

As a Data Engineer, you will address challenges such as scalability, latency, and compliance, ensuring secure, high-quality data flows while collaborating in Agile teams. Your work will unlock data-driven insights, combining technical excellence with regulatory requirements to shape the bank’s future.

The Tribe Data Services comprises over 160 colleagues, organized into more than 10 squads, primarily based in Brussels, with some team members working nearshore or offshore.

AND IN DETAIL

As a Functional Data Engineer, you will:

• Build and maintain optimized data stores by designing, developing, and ensuring well-structured, high-performance data assets (e.g., databases) tailored for APIs, reporting, analytics, and BI tools.
• Enable data-driven decision-making by delivering reliable, accurate, and accessible data for business intelligence, reporting, and analysis services while maintaining related infrastructure.
• Collaborate with internal clients and teams as a trusted partner, understanding stakeholder needs, guiding them on data solutions, and working cross-functionally while adhering to Tribe methodologies and standards.
• Ensure compliance and risk management by strictly following data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR) and banking security policies, mitigating risks in data collection, processing, and storage to safeguard client and institutional data.
• Drive continuous improvement by proactively identifying opportunities to enhance data quality, efficiency, and innovation—whether through new tools, automation, or process optimizations—while aligning with business and regulatory requirements.
• Collect the data from the source and design it into models that will be used by developers.  In this role you are the bridge between the business needs and the developers. You translate requests into models that will be interpreted by the developers.
• Uphold data quality and governance by implementing validation rules, monitoring, and metadata management to maintain accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
• Support stakeholders and troubleshoot issues by resolving data incidents (e.g., broken pipelines, latency problems) and partnering with analysts, product owners, or business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions—such as creating self-service datasets or optimizing queries for reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• Education and experience:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT or engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
• Equivalent experience: minimum 3 years.
  
• Hard skills:
• Working experience with databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL.
• Knowledge of SQL, including writing complex queries and performance tuning.
• Profound Knowledge of data warehouse (DWH) modeling (e.g., Kimball, Inmon, Data Vault).
• Understanding or knowledge of ETL tools like Informatica PowerCenter.
• Understanding of Big Data technologies such as Spark, Astronomer.
• Extended knowledge of PowerDesigner tool (or equivalent)
  
• Soft skills:
• Problem-solving mindset: ability to troubleshoot complex data issues and propose scalable solutions.
• Collaboration: strong team player with experience in cross-functional Agile teams.
• Ownership and accountability: takes responsibility for data quality, delivery timelines, and system reliability.
• Communication: ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Continuous learning: stays updated on emerging data technologies.
  
• Languages:
• You communicate fluently in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an asset.
